meta.name: Rokar POS
meta.description: Rokar is a fast, offline-first billing & inventory POS for retail shops in Pakistan. Billing, udhaar (khata), stock audit, supplier tracking and reports -- all on one Windows app.
meta.ogTitle: Rokar POS -- Billing & Inventory for Pakistani Shops
meta.ogDescription: Offline-first POS with billing, udhaar khata, inventory, reports and thermal receipt printing. Built for small retail shops.

hero.eyebrow: Offline-First POS - Made for Pakistani Shops
hero.lead: Rokar is Pakistan's fastest offline billing & inventory software built specifically for retail dukaan owners. Scan barcodes, bill in 3 seconds, track udhaar (khata), and see daily net profit -- no internet needed.
hero.versionNote: 15 days free full trial with instant setup

features.eyebrow: Sab Kuch Ek Hi App Mein
features.lead: Rokar brings billing, stock, customer credit, and profit reports together -- replacing registers, lost udhaar pages, and mental math with 100% accurate computer records.

items.title: Fast Offline Billing
items.desc: Bill a whole customer in under 3 seconds. Barcode scan or 2-letter search. Works fully offline without ever needing internet.

items.title: Udhaar / Khata Ledger
items.desc: Customer credit accounts with 'Kitna baqi hai' at a glance. 1-click WhatsApp balance reminders prevent lost money.

items.title: Inventory & Stock Audit
items.desc: Real-time stock deduction, low-stock warnings, and full stock audit tools to match physical shelf items with system ledger.

items.title: Thermal & A4 Receipts
items.desc: Instant printing on 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt printers, barcode label generation, and elegant A4 tax invoices.

items.title: Purchases & Suppliers
items.desc: Record purchase bills, supplier dues, return vouchers, and track incoming stock costs with complete ledger history.

items.title: Daily Profit & Reports
items.desc: Today's sales, net profit, top-selling items, hourly rush trends, and monthly P&L exportable directly to Excel.

items.title: Multi-shift Cash Drawer
items.desc: Separate morning and evening cash drawers with end-of-shift cash counting. Know exactly how much each cashier collected.

items.title: Cashier & Owner Roles
items.desc: Owner, Manager, Cashier permissions. Cashiers can only bill; profit figures and sensitive settings stay locked for Owner only.

items.title: WhatsApp Digital Receipts
items.desc: Send itemized digital receipts straight to customer WhatsApp in 1 click. Saves thermal paper and looks ultra professional.

items.title: Daily Cloud Backup
items.desc: Automated daily encrypted backups to your Google Drive or OneDrive. If your PC ever crashes, your data is 100% safe.

items.title: Wholesale & Retail Modes
items.desc: Retail price for walk-in customers, wholesale rate for bulk thok buyers -- switch instantly at billing in one tap.

items.title: Barcode Label Generator
items.desc: Design and print your own custom barcode stickers for unbranded items directly from Rokar POS to any label printer.

industries.name: Kirana & Superstores
industries.desc: High-speed barcode checkout, bulk stock management, and customer udhaar khata.

industries.name: Pharmacy & Medical
industries.desc: Batch numbers, expiry date alerts, formula search, and supplier invoice records.

industries.name: Bakery & Sweets
industries.desc: Fast touch billing, kg & gram weight calculations, and multi-shift cash drawers.

industries.name: Garments & Footwear
industries.desc: Color, size, and brand variants with custom barcode sticker printing.

industries.name: Wholesale & Electronics
industries.desc: Carton & loose unit billing, serial/IMEI warranty tracking, and dual wholesale pricing.
points: Wholesale rate vs retail rate toggle

steps.title: Live billing in 4 simple steps
steps.lead: Aaj hi shuru kijiye -- no training course, no IT team needed. Sirf 1 Windows PC.

items.title: Download & Install
items.desc: Download the free Windows installer (under 80MB). One-click setup. No technical skills needed.

items.title: Add Your Products
items.desc: Import from Excel or add manually. Scan your existing barcodes. Takes 30 minutes for a full store setup.

items.title: Start Billing
items.desc: Scan or search items, generate bill, print receipt or send to WhatsApp. Your staff learns in under 1 hour.

items.title: See Your Profit
items.desc: Check today's net sales and profit. Review udhaar balances. Export monthly report to Excel in 1 click.

pricing.lead: No hidden fees. No annual lock-in. Start with 15-day free full trial. Pay only when you're 100% satisfied.
pricing.note: Every plan starts with a 15-day completely free full trial. No credit card required. Instant WhatsApp setup support included.

packages.name: Starter
packages.sub: Single PC, small kirana, medical or bakery

download.lead: Windows 10 & 11 ready. Under 80MB. One-click install. No internet needed after setup.

faq.q: Kya software completely offline kaam karta hai?
faq.a: Haan, 100%. Billing, stock, reports -- sab offline kaam karta hai. Internet sirf cloud backup ke liye chahiye.

faq.q: Kya ek se zyada cashier use kar sakte hain?
faq.a: Pro aur Multi-Branch plans mein multiple cashier accounts hain with separate shift reports.

faq.q: Trial ke baad data save rehta hai?
faq.a: Haan, aapka pura data (products, customers, bills) safe rehta hai jab aap paid version activate karein.

faq.q: Setup mein kitna waqt lagta hai?
faq.a: 15 minute install, 30 minute product entry. Hum AnyDesk par free remote setup bhi dete hain.

footer.tiny: Made for the shopkeepers of Pakistan. 100% local data, always private.

testimonials.name: Tariq Sahab
testimonials.text: 3 branches ka data ek jagah, profit reports daily email par. Bohot shandar system hai.

testimonials.name: Sana Bibi
testimonials.text: Weighing scale se connect ho gaya aur per-kg billing automatic. Bohot time bachata hai.
